milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because crafting birch planks from birch logs places the planks directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with 2 birch_log and 0 birch_planks, so this rule is not pre-satisfied. Once the player crafts any birch log into planks, at least 4 birch_planks will appear in inventory, exceeding the min_count of 1.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a fishing rod (3 sticks + 2 string in a 3×3 crafting table grid) places the fishing rod directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 fishing_rod, so this rule is not pre-satisfied. The player must first craft birch_planks into sticks (intermediate step), then combine 3 sticks + 2 string in the diagonal fishing rod recipe on the crafting table.
